title: Padding & Margin: Spacing Mastery 🧹
description: Longhand, shorthand, collapsing margins, and centring with auto.

slides.title: Padding: Inside Space 🛋️
Padding Shorthand Examples
slides.codeSnippet:
.box1 { padding: 15px; }           /* all 15px */
.box2 { padding: 10px 25px; }      /* top/bottom 10px, left/right 25px */
.box3 { padding: 5px 10px 15px; }  /* top 5, right 10, bottom 15, left 10 (mirrored) */
.box4 { padding: 5px 10px 15px 20px; } /* top, right, bottom, left */

quizData.question: What does `padding: 10px 20px 30px;` set?
quizData.explanation: Three values: top, right & left, bottom. So left = right = 20px.

slides.title: Margin: Outside Space 🌌
slides.content:
# Push Elements Away

`margin` creates space outside the border, separating elements. Like padding, it has longhand and shorthand (same pattern).

Key differences:
- Margins can be **negative** (pulling elements closer or overlapping).
- Margins are **transparent**, background doesn't extend into them.
- Vertical margins can **collapse** (more on that next).

```css
p {
  margin-bottom: 1.5em;
}
```
You can use `auto` on left/right margins of a block to centre it horizontally.

slides.title: Margin Collapse 🧲
slides.content:
# When Margins Overlap Vertical margins of adjacent block elements sometimes **collapse** – the larger margin wins, not the sum. ```css h2 { margin-bottom: 30px; } p { margin-top: 20px; } ``` The gap between the `

` and `

` will be 30px, not 50px. Margins collapse only vertically (top/bottom), not horizontally (left/right). This happens between parent and first/last child too (with some conditions). Padding/borders prevent it.

quizData.question: Horizontal margins (left and right) also collapse.
quizData.explanation: Margin collapse only affects vertical margins (top and bottom).

slides.title: Centering with `margin: auto`
Pro Tip 🚀
slides.content:
## Use Padding for Clickable Area

On buttons or links, increase padding to enlarge the touch target. It's better than adding fixed width/height because it respects content size.
